description:
THE CAMPAIGN fz-kdt.83's census indicated (~half of analysis work re-derives
unchanged conclusions), now with the mechanism narrowed by two verified
facts (2026-08-31, recipes: census logs at 84ae179b4 + code reads):

1. STALE WAKES REFUTED: 0 of 192/85/171 zero-change evals were woken by a
   fact they no longer read -- every waking movement is genuinely consumed.
2. THE CONSUMPTION ALGEBRA: a callee's raw ReturnType enters the caller via
   refine_call_return = MEET with the contract (jobs/semantic.rs:1246), then
   flows into published outputs through cross-row/cross-path JOINS
   (merge_value_types column-wise, coalesce, replace_targets_join_returns,
   reachable-set unions). So a movement changes nothing when it is
   (a) MASKED: old MEET c == new MEET c (the contract already clipped it), or
   (b) ABSORBED: the join over sibling rows/paths already covers it.
   Wake causes of the zero-change class: ReturnType 121/42/134,
   FunctionContract 65/30/33 -- both sides of the same meet.

## The design question (full treatment: dig -> cold proposal -> integrate)
A wake-time CUTOFF: when fact F moves old->new, a subscriber whose every
consumption of F is masked/absorbed need not run. Soundness demands
enumerating EVERY consumption path (the census hazard note: whole-eval
subsumption gating is unsound in general -- downstream callsite KEYS are
minted from raw refined values, so an unmasked raw movement propagates
non-monotonically). First dig step: VERIFY the masking hypothesis
empirically -- for each zero-change eval's ReturnType cause, test
old MEET contract == new MEET contract (probe at the wake or define site);
classify the FunctionContract causes symmetrically. If masking+absorption
does not account for the bulk, the mechanism hunt continues before any
design.

## Constraints
Engine stays domain-free (a cutoff hook is a domain callback in the
ClaimShape mold, or the movement classification extends is_cumulative's
algebra -- the fz-kdt.74 review already flagged that a third movement class
is a NEW ENGINE CONCEPT: cost it explicitly). Zero-uncaused must hold (a
cut-off wake must be provably conclusion-preserving, not heuristic).
Per-output granularity rides the 13.1 derivation substrate if needed.
Work counts, canon byte-compare, inventory pins as always.
title: Wake cutoff: movements masked by meet-with-contract or absorbed by cross-row joins
